appDescription: Keeps the business vehicle logbook by recording every trip from the car odometer.

function.name: SET_TRIP_CATEGORY
function.description: Marks a trip in the vehicle logbook as business use, commute between home and office, or personal use.

trip.description: Which trip to change: the trip being driven now, the trip that just ended, or the next departure.

function.name: ADD_TRIP_NOTE
function.description: Saves the purpose of the visit as a note on the trip that just ended in the vehicle logbook.

note.description: Short visit purpose in the user's own words.

function.name: SET_TRIP_USER
function.description: Records in the vehicle logbook which registered person is driving or using the shared car on the trip.

name.description: Name of the person driving or using the car.
